title.narrative: Enhancing and sustaining access to safe water, sanitation, hygiene practices for women, men, girls, boys in drought-affected people of Lasqoray .

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project aims to deliver emergency life-saving WASH services to 11,190 vulnerable individuals, including 3,250 women, 3,015 girls, 1,912 men, 3,013 boys, and persons with disabilities (PWDs), particularly in Lasqoray rural communities and among drought-displaced populations, elderly, and those with disabilities. To address the ongoing drought crisis, the project will establish a new shallow well in Durduri 10 to 20 meters deep and rehabilitate an existing borehole in Ulxeed equipping it with solar-powered system to ensure reliable access to sufficient water. Works will include community kiosks and animal troughs. The Ceelaayo borehole will undergo comprehensive rehabilitation, which involves replacing the submersible pump, raising pipes, cables, and the generator, as well as rehabilitating the elevated water tank to restore its functionality. In Buran village, water access will be improved by replacing over 1,500 meters of old pipes. ltbrgt Habarshiro, Kaladhacda, Sibaaayo, Balibusle, Caadsaran villages and Dhanaha IDP camp will receive emergency water trucking services delivering 2,400, 000 liters over three months to support pastoralist communities in surrounding areas to meet urgent water needs. To ensure the sustainability of water infrastructure, a budget for operations and maintenance contingencies will be allocated, coupled with regular monitoring to assess facility performance and water quality. The project also emphasizes capacity building training 30 local operators and community members in management and maintenance practices, as well as providing technical training for 50 community members and WASH personnel. 16,000 Aqua Tabs will be distributed through public institutions including schools, MCH facilities to promote access to potable water for 4,000 HHs. Feedback mechanisms will be established to enhance transparency and enable continuous improvement of WASH services across all target locations. TASS will empower community members through awareness on protection sanitation and hygiene promotion meetings and distribution of IEC materials and billboards with context related and locally accepted messages to promote gender equality, PSEA prevention, and sanitation hygiene practices. ltbrgtlt/pgt
